crop_preprocessing: Original RGB pixels; YOLO bbox with 5% padding; trusted SAM mask where available, outside pixels neutral RGB 128; Resize shortest side to 256, CenterCrop 224, ImageNet mean/std; same transform for all candidates.
prototype_selection: Only V2.3 trusted YOLO local observations with confidence >= 0.5, accepted SAM mask, no V2.2 drift flag, and YOLO/SAM bbox IoU >= 0.5; at most two highest-confidence frames per local track, four total; never from CONFLICT/AMBIGUOUS/SAM-only.
candidate_views: One frozen YOLO-seeded SAM mask at first late candidate frame 528 for each of all three candidates; no GT selection.
similarity_metric: L2-normalized penultimate pooled feature cosine; maximum over trusted prototypes; all per-prototype scores recorded.
semantic_gate: Phone-like classes compatible; incompatible known classes REJECT.
contradiction_gates: Reliable same-frame distinct current observations of query and candidate REJECT; known semantic contradiction REJECT; stale memory alone is not coexistence.
temporal_rule: Candidate first seen strictly after query last trusted observation; no long-gap pixel-position extrapolation.
context_rule: V2.3 image-plane graph neighborhood is recorded if available, never sufficient alone for MATCH; no world-fixed anchors.
candidate_quality_rule: First candidate SAM mask must be nonempty and originate from a frozen YOLO phone detection; otherwise AMBIGUOUS.
weak_appearance_rule: Below 0.60 remains AMBIGUOUS unless independent contradiction exists; appearance alone never forces NEW_ENTITY or REJECT.
threshold_rationale: Allowed controls only: task2 track22-to-track43 positive max cosine 0.7113 and task1 original-phone-to-later-desk negative 0.3642. Threshold 0.60 sits between them; margin 0.10 is a conservative prespecified separation. No task2 late candidate similarity or identity was inspected.
